**TL;DR**

- **A rotation day, not a risk-on day.** S&P 500 +0.28% to 7,712.57, Dow +1.02% to 52,495.88, Russell 2000 +1.65% to 2,773.42 — but the Nasdaq Composite closed **red**, 26,424.82 (-0.02%).
- Equal-weight S&P (RSP) +1.15% vs SPY +0.34%: leadership was **3.4x broader** than the cap-weighted index. Small caps (IWM +1.66%) beat large caps by ~5x.
- **Healthcare led and hit a record high** (XLV +2.37%); real estate (+1.70%) and utilities (+1.26%) outperformed. **Technology was the only sector down** (XLK -0.28%). 10 of 11 sector ETFs rose.
- **Vol cooled** — VIX 17.31 (-6.13%, off an intraday 19.13), VXN 25.56 (-5.79%). 10-year yield 5.117% (-0.37%), TLT +0.84%.
- **Three after-hours events matter:** Supermicro **+12.5%** on a preliminary FY27 Q1 revenue/margin raise; Netflix **-4.9%** on Q3; SpaceX **+2.1%** on Q3.
- DELL +4.1% / HPE +3.3% are AI-server sympathy off the SMCI print.
- **Day's largest regular-session mover was M&A, not earnings:** Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for ~$5.66B EV ($47.50/sh cash, +58.1% to $30.04) — **BRZE +51.70%**.
- **Tomorrow (Oct 21):** META + TSLA after the close, LRCX in the afternoon, PM/DHR/ELV before the open; **20-yr bond auction 1:00 PM ET**, EIA crude 10:30 AM ET.
- No CPI, payrolls or FOMC this week.

**5. After-hours earnings reactions**

**Supermicro (SMCI) — preliminary FY2027 Q1 business update, 16:30 ET**

Released 1:30 p.m. PDT, Oct 20, 2026. ([Yahoo Finance / Business Wire](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/supermicro-provides-first-quarter-fiscal-203000342.html))

- **Metric**: Net sales (Q1 FY27) · **New preliminary**: $18.5B – $19.5B · **Prior guidance**: $14.5B – $15.5B · **Delta**: +$4.0B at both ends (midpoint $15.0B → $19.0B)
- **Metric**: Gross margin · **New preliminary**: 12.0% – 12.5% · **Prior guidance**: 10.4% – 10.8% · **Delta**: +1.6 – 1.7 pts

- Company attributed the revenue raise primarily to **greater demand for AI platforms**; the margin raise primarily to **customer and product mix**.
- **No GAAP or non-GAAP EPS disclosed. No quantified orders/backlog figure.** Full-year FY27 guidance was not revised in this release.
- Earnings call: **Nov 3, 2026, 5:00 p.m. ET**. Stock **+12.50%** to $36.53 at 16:39 ET.
- DELL +4.08% and HPE +3.34% are the sympathy trade. Note DELL trades ex a $0.63 dividend today (ex-date 10-20), so the $18.84 AH gain is not a dividend artifact.

**Netflix (NFLX) — Q3 2026, 16:01 ET**

- Stock **-4.92%** to $65.31 at 16:39 ET, after closing -1.66% at $68.69.
- Pre-print bar: revenue $12.86B (+11.7% y/y, company guide), operating margin 33.2%, diluted EPS $0.82; FY26 guide $51.0–51.4B revenue at 31.5% operating margin, implying a Q4 of ~$13.33–13.73B at ~27.5% margin.
- Consensus ~$12.88B / $0.82. Options priced a **±9.5%** move ([regardsofwallstreet](https://www.regardsofwallstreet.com/today)).
- Stock was down ~25% YTD ($93.76 at end-2025 vs $69.85 on 10-19) and had fallen after each of its **last five** reports (avg -6.9%) ([EBC](https://www.ebc.com/forex/netflix-earnings-preview-q3-2026-nflx-stock)).
- Support zone cited at $69.11–$70.51; the AH break puts it below.
- **Reported Q3 figures were not retrievable from indexed sources at writing time —
- only the market reaction is asserted here.** Do not read the -4.9% as a revenue vs margin verdict without the print.
- Pre-existing context: ~1,000 staff cut (~6% of workforce), CCO Bela Bajaria replaced by Peter Rice (effective Oct 26), ad revenue targeted to roughly double to ~$3B for 2026.

**SpaceX (SPCX) — Q3 2026, after the bell; webcast 16:30 ET**

- Stock **+2.09%** to $150.88 at 16:39 ET, from a $147.79 close (-0.11%). Volume 89.4M vs 95.2M 3M avg.
- Consensus bar: revenue **~$12.7B** (LSEG $12.72B / EPS 13c; Bloomberg ~$12.7B, adj EPS $0.15, adj EBITDA $6.59B).
- Q2 baseline: revenue $7.81B (+92% y/y), adj EBITDA $3.54B, **net loss $541M**, AI capex $15.83B. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/spacex-spcx-earnings-live-updates-q3-2026html.html/), [techi](https://www.techi.com/spacex-q3-earnings-oct-20-what-changed-since-q2/))
- Second public-company report since the June 12 IPO. **Lockup overhang:** 1.3B shares eligible for sale from Oct 22, plus 328M on Oct 24.
- **Reported figures not yet in indexed sources at writing time.** 24/7 Wall St earlier in the session noted shares had plunged ~14% after the prior report.
